translation: <ins>Palpation method (摸法)</ins> Palpation means using the hand to feel carefully over the injured place, whether the bone is broken, shattered, deviated, intact, soft, or hard; whether the sinew is stiff, soft, deviated, straight, severed, displaced, thick, turned over, cold, or hot; as well as the exterior-interior, deficiency-excess, and whether the affliction is new or old. First palpate whether it was a fall, a misstep, or a blow, then treat it according to the method. <ins>Joining method (接法)</ins> Joining means causing the already-broken bone to come together in one place and return to its former state.
